race.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
race.verdict: Making his third start back this season, EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY ran well when second at Punchestown and he can build on that effort to go one better from what remains a handy mark. Heading the list of dangers is Mickey Cohen who arrives on the back of a win over hurdles, while Mistyburn and Knocknagoran Lady could also be in the mix. EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY (IRE) MICKEY COHEN (IRE) MISTYBURN (IRE)
